snapshot.text: Morocco is extending mandatory health insurance (AMO) to the whole population and reorganising care through regional territorial health groups. A new health minister took office in October 2026; overcrowded emergency rooms and regional inequality are key problems.

minister.name: Younes Bjijou
minister.role: Minister of Health and Social Protection

priorities.title: Territorial health groups
priorities.text: The reform creating regional territorial health groups faces its first real test in the field.

priorities.title: New hospitals and health centres
priorities.text: 15 hospital projects due in 2026, 67 new health centres across six regions and a 380-bed specialty hospital in Tetouan.

priorities.title: Emergency room overcrowding
priorities.text: A reform plan addresses overcrowded emergency rooms.
